title: Acts Bible Quiz - Chapter 24
description: Ten questions on Acts 24: the accusation by Tertullus, Paul's defense before Felix, and the two years that followed.

questions.text: Who was the orator who came down with the high priest Ananias to inform the governor against Paul?
questions.explanation: After five days the high priest, Ananias, came down with certain elders and an orator, one Tertullus.

questions.text: What did Tertullus call Paul when he began to accuse him?
questions.explanation: Tertullus called him a plague, an instigator of insurrections among all the Jews, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes.

answers.text: A teacher of a new law for the city of Rome
A false prophet who came out of Galilee
A thief who robbed the temple treasury
A plague and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes

questions.text: How long did Paul say it had been since he went up to worship at Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Paul said the governor could verify that it was not more than twelve days since he went up to worship at Jerusalem.

questions.text: What does Paul say his accusers call the Way?
questions.explanation: Paul confesses that after the Way, which they call a sect, he serves the God of his fathers.

questions.text: What hope toward God does Paul say he has, which his accusers also look for?
questions.explanation: Paul says he has hope toward God that there will be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.

answers.text: That the temple will be rebuilt in glory
That Rome will be judged by the law
That the nations will come to Jerusalem
That there will be a resurrection of the just and the unjust

questions.text: Why did Paul say he had come to his nation after some years?
questions.explanation: Paul says he came to bring gifts for the needy to his nation, and offerings.

answers.text: To gather a crowd in the temple
To bring gifts for the needy and offerings
To collect letters from the chief priests
To stand trial before the council

questions.text: Whose arrival did Felix say he would wait for before deciding the case?
questions.explanation: Felix deferred them, saying that when Lysias, the commanding officer, came down, he would decide their case.

questions.text: Who came with Felix when he sent for Paul and heard him concerning the faith in Christ Jesus?
questions.explanation: After some days Felix came with Drusilla, his wife, who was a Jewess, and sent for Paul.

questions.text: How did Felix react as Paul reasoned about righteousness, self-control and the judgment to come?
questions.explanation: Felix was terrified and told Paul to go his way for that time, saying he would summon him when it was convenient.

answers.text: He had Paul beaten and chained
He set Paul free at once
He laughed and called Paul crazy
He was terrified and sent Paul away for the time

questions.text: Who succeeded Felix when two years were fulfilled?
questions.explanation: When two years were fulfilled, Felix was succeeded by Porcius Festus, and Felix left Paul in bonds to gain favor with the Jews.
